title: The World According To Star Wars

questions.q: What did George Lucas initially want the alien and human roles to be?
questions.why: He first imagined aliens as heroes and humans as villains.

questions.q: How many drafts did Lucas write before finalizing the first film?
questions.why: He wrote four different drafts before being content.

questions.q: Which two non‑creative factors does the author credit for Star Wars' mega‑success?
questions.why: The text lists timing and luck as the key external factors.

questions.q: What historical mood in the US helped Star Wars resonate in 1977?
questions.why: The US was in a grim mood after multiple assassinations.

questions.q: What central right does the book say Star Wars explores?
questions.why: It states Star Wars is about the freedom of choice.
